summaries: A Form 10-K annual report for ADM ENDEAVORS, INC. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Statements of Operations report an operating loss of $121,237 for 2020. As the request targets the operating profit trend from 2021 to 2024, this document serves only as the pre-trend baseline and contains no operating profit figures for the specified years.

An SEC Form 10-K Annual Report for ADM ENDEAVORS, INC. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Statements of Operations report Operating Income of $715,076 for 2021 and Operating Loss of $(121,237) for 2020. This document provides the 2021 data point necessary to begin the requested 2021–2024 operating profit trend, but does not contain operating profit data for the years 2022, 2023, or 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for ADM ENDEAVORS, INC. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Statements of Operations (Page 16) provide operating income figures for 2022 ($353,044) and 2021 ($715,076), supplying the necessary data points for the middle of the requested 2021–2024 trend. While this document establishes the 2022 operating profit and confirms the 2021 comparative, it lacks results for 2023 and 2024, requiring combination with other filings to assess the full trend through 2024.

A Form 10-K annual report for ADM ENDEAVORS, INC. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Statements of Operations report operating income of $353,044 for 2022 and $91,884 for 2023. This document supplies the 2023 data point required for the trend analysis, confirming the 2022 figure previously identified in the collection. It does not contain historical data for 2021 or forward-looking data for 2024, necessitating reliance on other documents for those periods to complete the 2021–2024 trend review.
